answer: Each identity stakes 140 POA to plant one juniper sapling in the shared willow grove: the sapling grows only when its owner stands before the grove mirror at dusk and reads the day's work aloud while two neighbors watch; a sapling that wilts is uprooted, the 140 POA kept, the owner barred five epochs; ten clones need ten saplings, ten mirrors, ten separate dusk readings = 1,400 POA, no sapling/mirror/reading shared or reused.
